query:
SELECT COUNT(*)::bigint AS "count!"
            FROM collection_definitions cd
            WHERE cd.kind = 'tmdb_collection'
              AND cd.source = 'tmdb'
              AND cd.deleted_at IS NULL
              AND (
                    SELECT COUNT(*)::bigint
                    FROM collection_source_memberships csm
                    JOIN movie_references mr
                      ON csm.media_type = 'movie'::media_type
                     AND csm.media_id = mr.id
                    JOIN media_files mf ON mf.id = mr.file_id
                    WHERE csm.collection_id = cd.id
                      AND mf.is_available
                  ) >= $1::bigint
